svg.font-family: Inter, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: G1BoxGrasp phase loop
svg.text: nearest box resting on the belt,
body still → arms bend to the ready pose
over the corners · tare · straight down;
placed in box frame · short: grip higher
thumbs onto the front face, fingers
curl in + arms close until F_req held
1 over the slot · 2 lower to touchdown
Fail(reason) from any phase → Recover (counts against the box; MaxBoxAttempts → skip it until it moves)
Start: missing ChuteEntity / PlaceTarget, pelvis, boxes, actuator, site, wrist link → stop (no retry)
Track: box gone (> 0.25 m from the reach start, or off the belt)
RetrySqueeze: grip too weak after MaxSqueezeTries
Hold: box slipped > 5 cm · WalkStalled: > MaxWalkRetries · Turn: stalled after MaxTurnTries · table full → stop
g1_grasp.cs · every Advance / Enter / Fail edge
Drive(0,0,0) unless the phase walks / turns
held while a hand climbs out of a low spot
PATH min-jerk segments: up to the safe
TRACK hands follow the box until the first
WALK steer far, step holonomic < 0.4 m
Stalled(): no progress for StallTime (3 s)
WalkToBox ✗ grasp from where it stands
LiftBox ✗ open again after the grip
CarryToTable ✗ put it back where picked
RepeatLoop ✗ stop after one box / failure
